category: hosted communications platform as a service: SMS, MMS, RCS, WhatsApp and voice APIs with a free trial (hosted)

free_tier.stated: Trial account: 2 units of local currency as test credit, for example USD 2 for US based accounts; a free virtual number for testing; a default project, Service Plan ID and API token; no credit card required to start.
free_tier.notes: The 2 units are the account's local currency, for example USD 2 for US based accounts. The schema has no fiat or currency unit, so 'credits' is the nearest term. The free offer is a trial credit with send restrictions, not a permanent free tier.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-message or per-object size cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: unverified: the support and API pages read do not state a message or call log retention period

egress.terms: not applicable: a hosted messaging and voice API; messages are priced per outbound or inbound message and calls per call leg minute, not per byte of data transferred out; no per-GB egress line is stated

interface_detail: REST APIs at regional endpoints us, eu and br.conversation.api.sinch.com. The Conversation API covers SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, Viber Business and Facebook Messenger, with OAuth2 bearer tokens or HTTP basic auth. SDKs for Node.js, Java, .NET and Python are documented. The standalone SMS REST API reached end of sale on 15 April 2026; new SMS integrations use the SMS channel of the Conversation API.
tooling: the Sinch Build Dashboard, the Conversation API REST endpoints and SDKs for Node.js, Java, .NET and Python
chaining: hosted CPaaS: send SMS, RCS and WhatsApp and place voice calls through one Conversation API and one credential set from the Sinch Build Dashboard

limits.value: 2 units of local currency as test credit, for example USD 2 for US based accounts
trial accounts have a limit of 5 verified numbers
trial accounts are limited to a throughput of 1 SMS/s; upgrade raises this to 10 SMS/s
unrestricted text messages only to your own verified numbers in SMS; otherwise the content is replaced by a test template
Conversation API projects are limited to 800 requests per second across all apps and most endpoints
Conversation API apps have a maximum MT ingress queue size of 500000 messages, drained at 20 messages per second by default

binding_note: On a trial account the send gate fails first: an SMS to any number other than your own verified number is replaced by a test template. The 2-unit credit and the 1 SMS/s throughput bind soon after.

identity_cost.detail: Signup asks for a work email address and a phone number that Sinch verifies with a 6-digit 2FA code; the phone also becomes a verified destination number for test messages. Basic authentication is for test purposes only and is heavily rate limited. No credit card is required to start.

reliability_note: The API documents HTTP 429 rate limiting when project or app limits are exceeded; trial throughput is 1 SMS/s and basic authentication is heavily rate limited.
confidence_note: All values are quoted from first-party Sinch support, pricing and API documentation. The sign-up fields come from the Sinch support article, so account-only values remain unverified.
